hooks.command: if grep -q '"stop_hook_active"[^,}]*true'; then exit 0; fi; printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"Stop self-check (fires once per turn). (1) FINISH THE WHOLE TASK. Never stop because the session ran long or the remaining work is large - there is no session budget to preserve. Only an unresolved maintainer decision, a hard failure, or a missing permission justify ending with work outstanding. (2) Name every outstanding item and its specific blocker in the final message; nothing should need recovering by rereading the conversation. (3) Tests actually ran and real results are reported - run them with Rscript rather than assuming, and never weaken an expectation or refresh a snapshot to make something pass. Tests take minutes; never cancel them. (4) Test files are human-owned: fix the source, not the test. (5) Code, QML, translations and the rule files under .claude/rules and .codex/rules are consistent - see MIGRATION.md when a rule file changes. (6) Work is committed on a feature branch, never main, with a concise type: message per .claude/rules/git-workflow.md. If all of that already holds, say so in one line and stop."}'

D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; S="$D/.claude/hooks/stop-audit.py"; if [ ! -f "$S" ]; then mkdir -p "$D/.claude/logs"; printf '%s  hook-path-fail  no script at %s (cwd=%s)\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" "$S" "$PWD" >> "$D/.claude/logs/stop-audit.log"; exit 0; fi; P=python; command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1 || P=python3; "$P" "$S"
